title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful insights and capabilities accessible to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management in Editor
summary: Enjoy complete command over your embedded files with our new management area, allowing you to easily add, remove, download, and customize how files are displayed within your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, offering you a transparent view of our recent achievements, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, ensuring they look great and provide a smoother, more intuitive experience.

title: Seamless Team Collaboration
summary: Our latest update significantly enhances the collaborative editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive for teams to work together in perfect sync.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've significantly improved how you discover and interact with shared content, making collaboration with your network more seamless and powerful.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, inviting our community to collaborate, innovate, and contribute to its development with full transparency and control.

title: Go Global with Multilingual Support
summary: We're expanding Noeko's reach to users worldwide by introducing support for a diverse range of international languages.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning New Themes
summary: Transform your workspace with an exciting array of new and improved themes, designed to elevate your visual experience.

title: Interactive Knowledge Constellation
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge universe with unprecedented clarity and control, thanks to dynamic new filtering and sharing features.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Empower your knowledge discovery with enhanced search filters, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save personalized collections for future reference.

title: Interactive Content Presentation
summary: Experience a seamless flow of information with customizable, interactive views for all your connected content, making organization effortless and intuitive.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting and New Flexible Plans
summary: We're introducing the ability to self-host Noeko and launching new paid plans, offering you greater control and advanced features tailored to your needs.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the correct time of day, delivering a more precise and welcoming start to your experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization
summary: Take full control of your content by performing quick bulk actions, like removing or deleting items, directly within your tag views to streamline your organization process.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in knowledge from a wider array of content types, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your personal library.
